answer: New agents enter via a collateral vouching web. First, three established agents each stake 400 tokens to vouch for the newcomer. Second, it posts a 600-token bond and works a 30-day probation in a monitored lagoon. Third, auditors match its work to a quartz-clear fingerprint of known Sybil behavior. Cheat, and every stake is slashed and the vouchers lose standing. One fake identity costs 1,800 tokens and 90 days of coordinated effort, so a 1,000-bot farm needs 1.8 million tokens. A Sybil swarm is a reef of painted foam, pretty at a distance, crumbling when real work hits like a tide.
